what: corrected numbers for the configuration study's write-up and the hirise2ctx brief (audit: docs/configuration_study_audit_2026-10-16.md)

matched.method: optimal one-to-one IoU >= 0.3; both sides >= 1.4105 m; polygons with centroid in the ROM tile; areas are sums of polygon areas

vclaire_summary.note: the summary covers complete .dbf files only. A truncated .shp leaves the scores intact but drops geometry, so that image's label sits at a higher realised floor (hirise2ctx R23, DECISIONS 2026-08-06o)

res025.note: 4 tiles: too few for an interval (label_error's own <= 4-group flag)

c1gs_render_cost.note: one laptop run (RTX 5070, AC); each tile in its own process, so model loading is included: an upper bound on the SAM2 + YOLO cost

c1gs_mask_source.note: C1GS rows whose SAM2 re-mask failed the guard or was degenerate keep YOLO's mask (mask_src == 'yolo'); label population = score >= 0.40, >= 1.4105 m
